subject: how do you forcefully end the run of your MakeADFun to avoid being aborted?

messages.author: 361e593259030741
messages.subject: how do you forcefully end the run of your MakeADFun to avoid being aborted?
parts:
Hi. 
Sometimes the run of a MakeADFun aborts/terminates the R studio environment.  This means that its CPP file has errors.  The termination forces me to newly restart the whole process.  
I wonder whether there is a command in a CPP file, comparable to "exit(any positive integer)" in a TPL file for ADMB. 

When using ADMB, I intentionally end the running of an executable file wherever I want to end it by inserting "exit(any positive integer)" in a TPL file.  This trick is greatly helpful when finding errors in the TPL code *without* restarting the whole process.  If the tmb folks do that kind of trick, then would you share it? 

Thanks,
Saang-Yoon

I recall to have some messages lately about how to make debugging work also under Windows, so maybe it should be updated.
